ticket.summary: Kitchen sink faucet supply line split and spraying; customer closed both fixture shutoffs and leak is contained — needs supply line replacement first thing Tue AM.
mitigation_advice: Closed both hot and cold fixture shutoff valves under the kitchen sink (clockwise until snug) [PB-01]
Leave valves closed, do not use the kitchen faucet, towel/bucket under the fitting for residual drip [PB-01]
If spraying resumes, shut off the house main (clockwise / lever perpendicular) [PB-02] and open the lowest cold tap to drain pressure [PB-03]

quote_lines.description: Replace split kitchen faucet supply line (braided line, hot and/or cold)

ticket.customer_message: You handled it like a pro, Dana — genuinely. You're booked: Tue Sept 1, 8:00-9:00 AM, supply line replacement, $129 flat. Keep both under-sink valves closed until we arrive, towel down any drips, and text this number if anything changes overnight. See you in the morning!
